description: Mirror of electron/UpdateChannelPolicy.ts UPDATE_TRUST_POLICY (runtime source of truth). Consumed by release tooling and sync-checked by tests/electron/UpdateChannelPolicy.test.ts. When a Windows code-signing certificate is provisioned: set expectedSignerSubject here AND in the TS constant, configure electron-builder signing env (CSC_LINK / CSC_KEY_PASSWORD), and flip build/release-policy.json windows.requireAuthenticode to true.
